ETc equals ETo times Kc by definition of the coefficient.

engineering: Engineering view: health in an inhabited place rests on safe water, excreta disposal, hand hygiene, and food hygiene — the classic WASH set. Science proof: faecal-oral transmission is the established mechanism for diarrhoeal pathogens, and randomized and quasi-experimental WASH studies measure reductions in diarrhoea incidence when transmission routes are blocked. Chlorination at 0.2 to 0.5 milligrams per litre free residual chlorine is the standard operational range for safe piped water.

Mathematics: The demo combines three independent risk reductions — water 30 percent, sanitation 30 percent, handwashing 30 percent — multiplicatively, showing the combined remaining risk.
